name: -Fragment♪-
source:
A wicked (?) tomboy succubus (boyish girl) lures men with her sensual breasts...

The protagonist is a heroic shonen who gets slurped up by the succubus's seductions! Will he endure, or have a weakened "bad end"?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE084463.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
邪恶的（？）假小子魅魔（孩子气的女孩）用她性感的乳房引诱男人……

主角是被魅魔诱惑的英雄少年！他会忍受下去，还是会有一个被削弱的“坏结局”？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE084463.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
